description: Works to a tree covered by  LBE ORDER NO 1:T1 Cedar - fell to ground level.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The application is unsupported by the required arboricultural information. The stated reason for the works relates to the tree's condition, yet the application form indicates otherwise, resulting in an unsubstantiated and contradictory proposal.

The Local Planning Authority do not consider that the grounds specified by the applicant/agent (i.e. tree owner concern) sufficient reason without further substantiation to justify the proposed removal of a mature and prominent tree of significant amenity that makes a positive contribution to the amenity of the locality and wider borough.
